verdict.rationale: Slack documents data export/import tools for admins (slack-docs-22/23/35/36) and retention is tied to plan tier (slack-comm-6), suggesting some control exists. However, a hands-on account describes that even paying business customers cannot self-serve export their chat data — Corporate Export requires Slack's approval and is gated to compliance cases ('so they have the tech built, you just aren't allowed to use it') — directly contradicting the implied self-service retention/deletion control. Missing for 10: clear documentation of deletion controls (not just export), API-level retention policy management, and independent confirmation that admins can freely control retention/export without vendor gatekeeping.
